card: Put your work history into a structured resume.
title: ClearHire for your next resume
intro: ClearHire brings your work history into a structured profile and an ATS-friendly resume. It also offers tools for the parts of a job search that take more than one draft.

sections.heading: What is ClearHire for?
sections.body: It is a place to build a sharper resume and be discovered.

sections.heading: How is a resume put together?
sections.body: Your profile is structured, and the resume builder follows an ATS-friendly format.

sections.heading: What else is available?
sections.body: Its career tools cover steps such as bullet writing and ATS checks; the source lists more than 50.

sections.heading: Where does ClearHire fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps people and work in your personal record. ClearHire turns work history toward a structured resume and job search.
